# Civic Web Index

> Civic Web Index performs lightweight, transparent, homepage-only checks of public-interest websites (government and nonprofit domains). It records availability, machine-readability, hosting/DNS hints, and automated accessibility signals. It does not bypass bot protections, crawl private areas, or perform vulnerability scanning.

This site exposes its own dataset through a JSON API.

## API

- [GET /api/summary](/api/summary): latest crawl run summary
- [GET /api/domains](/api/domains): paginated, filterable domain list (params: limit, offset, status, org_type, state, search)
- [GET /api/domains/{domain}](/api/domains/{domain}): full observation for a single domain
- [GET /api/stats/status](/api/stats/status): collection status breakdown
- [GET /api/stats/https](/api/stats/https): HTTPS/TLS adoption
- [GET /api/stats/hosting](/api/stats/hosting): hosting provider breakdown
- [GET /api/stats/files](/api/stats/files): robots.txt / sitemap.xml / llms.txt availability
- [GET /api/stats/accessibility](/api/stats/accessibility): static accessibility aggregates

## Source

- [cisagov/dotgov-data](https://github.com/cisagov/dotgov-data): current data source (.gov zone file)
